facts.fact: NTRA, through the Egyptian Computer Emergency Readiness Team (EG-CERT), is stated to represent Egypt in the ITU index; EG-CERT is stated to exist and play a role in cybersecurity cooperation. No date given, so the published date 2024-09-18 is used.
The document cites Egypt's National Cybersecurity Strategy (2023-2027) as a driver of its progress. No adoption date given, so the published date 2024-09-18 is used.
